description: Compares SLM-extracted relations against internal_refs/external_refs captured directly from the XML's own <intref>/<extref> tags in Stage 2.

unrecalled_provisions.heading: Outline of Part 5
unrecalled_provisions.reason: A table-of-contents-style outline provision ("This Part... is divided into 8 subparts..."), with 8 tagged internal references but no verbs indicating a power, duty, definition, citation, or amendment. The SLM returned an empty relations list rather than classifying it as cross_reference. A distinct, narrow pattern not otherwise observed in the dataset — not evidence of a systemic extraction weakness.
